# Hosea Chapter 14 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 332v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/HOS_014_page_001.jpg

---

**14:1** Return shuvah, Yisra'el, to YHWH your-God; for you-have-stumbled khashalta in-your-iniquity ba-avonekha.

**14:2** Take qechu with-you words devarim and-return veshuvu to YHWH; say imru to-him, "Take-away tissa all iniquity avon and-accept qach what is good tov, and-we-will-render u-neshallemah the-fruit parim of-our-lips sefateinu."

**14:4** "I-will-heal erpa their-turning-away meshuvotam; I-will-love-them ohavam freely nedavah; for my-anger appi has-turned shav from-him."

**14:5** "I-will-be ehyeh like-the-dew ka-tal to-Yisra'el; he-will-blossom yifrach like-the-lily ka-shushan, and-his-roots shorashav will-strike veyakh like-Lebanon."

**14:6** "His-branches yonoqotav will-spread yelkhu, and-his-beauty hodo will-be like-the-olive-tree ke-zayit, and-his-fragrance veriach lo like-Lebanon."

**14:7** "Those-who-dwell yoshevei in-his-shade be-tsillo will-return yashuvu; they-will-grow-grain yechayu dagan and-blossom veyifrechu like-the-vine ka-gafen; his-fame zikhro will be like-the-wine of-Lebanon."

**14:8** "Efrayim — what have I more od to do with-idols la-atsabbim? I have-answered aniti and-I-will-watch-over-him va'ashurennu; I am like-a-green ra'anan cypress berosh; from-me your-fruit perykha is-found nimtsa."

**14:9** Who is wise chakham and-will-understand veyaven these things elleh? Who-is-discerning navon and-will-know veyede'em them? For the-ways darkhei of-YHWH are straight yesharim, and-the-righteous tsaddiqim walk yelkhu in-them, and-the-transgressors u-fosh'im stumble yikkashlu in-them.

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

Hosea 14 continues the prophet's exploration of the marriage metaphor — YHWH as the faithful husband, Israel as the unfaithful wife. The chapter's power lies in the intersection of personal pain and national theology.

*— PNEUMA*
